Google News Archive Search}} Many players, including half of those drafted in the first round, signed with teams in the newly created [[American Football League]], including the [[List of first overall National Football League Draft picks|first overall pick]] and [[Heisman Trophy]] winner [[Billy Cannon]]. At the time of the draft, the Cardinals were still the Chicago Cardinals; they moved to St. Louis in March 1960.
